opportunities.title: Home bakers get premium prices for occasion cakes
opportunities.signal_summary: Customised occasion cakes from home bakers sell at a clear premium over standard bakery cakes, and a home-baker marketplace had launched in Pune.
opportunities.evidence: HomeBakers.co.in survey of 200+ bakers: average earnings about Rs 14,000/month; bakery cakes typically about Rs 500, while home bakers can get up to Rs 1,200 for occasion cakes. Platform had launched in Pune (2019).
opportunities.label: Verified against the cited source on 18 Nov 2026.

opportunities.title: Festive food ordering is strong in Pune
opportunities.signal_summary: Pune was among the top cities for festive sweet orders during Ganesh Chaturthi 2025, showing strong festive food-ordering demand. This is a sweets signal, not cakes specifically.
opportunities.evidence: Swiggy data: 2,28,102 modaks ordered nationwide during Ganesh Chaturthi 2025, led by Mumbai (69,240) and Pune (30,433).
opportunities.label: Verified against the cited source on 18 Nov 2026.

opportunities.title: Pune shop rents far exceed a small starting budget
opportunities.signal_summary: Monthly rent for a small retail shop in Pune is several times a ₹10,000 starting budget, so a shopfront is not realistic at this stage.
opportunities.evidence: Listing: 600 sq ft shop in Baner, Pune, for rent at ₹65,000 per month (listing seen on Housing.com; listings change, keep a dated screenshot).
opportunities.label: Rental listing snapshot, checked 18 Nov 2026; listings change.

opportunities.title: Pune has an established online cake marketplace
opportunities.signal_summary: Pune buyers already order cakes online from home bakers, which shows existing demand but also competition.
opportunities.evidence: Bakeway described as Pune's largest online cake marketplace, with more than 500 bakeries and home bakers on board (2018).
opportunities.label: Verified against the cited source on 18 Nov 2026.

opportunities.title: Pune home-baker custom cake prices
opportunities.signal_summary: Pune home bakers price custom cakes from about ₹700 to ₹1,500 per kg, and orders usually need a few days' notice.
opportunities.evidence: A Pune home baker offers customised cakes from INR 700/kg, with a popular cake at INR 1,500/kg; orders usually placed 2-3 days in advance. Another custom fondant baker is priced from INR 1,000 upwards.
opportunities.label: Verified against the cited source on 18 Nov 2026.
